services.desc: Tchah Sup Kim (1940-2022) was an artist whose lifelong practice explored fundamental questions of civilization, the universe, existence, and humanity. Moving beyond formal experimentation, his work sought new ways of seeing and understanding the world-often by challenging established boundaries between East and West, the individual and the cosmos, and the finite and the infinite. New York played a pivotal role in this artistic and intellectual journey. It was here that Kim encountered the center of Western modernism while also beginning to question its prevailing systems of thought.
